title: Fix stale plan removal flow
summary: The macOS approval app now removes stale plans reliably: queue cache invalidation is immediate, the last displayed stale request closes the approval attention window, and duplicate remove actions are prevented while in flight.
userVisibleChange: Removing a stale plan from the macOS approval app now removes it immediately and closes the empty approval window without resurrecting the stale row.

risks.title: A daemon mutation must publish a plan-queue change before the client refreshes

timeline.title: Implemented cache invalidation and macOS queue reconciliation
Verified API, Swift package, Xcode project, and Go suites

decisions.title: Invalidate the review-queue cache synchronously when a stale plan is dismissed
Treat displayed stale requests as part of queue-drained state
